text: s 的发生率较高且具有显著临床意义，科室内 DDIs 和科室间 DDIs 各占一半。科室间 DDIs 不能忽视。②不同的药物信息数据库对DDIs 的评价可能不同，临床应用时应综合参考不同数据库的评价。添加可以识别科室间DDIs 的预警软件，且药师参与该类患者的用药安全管理是十分必要的【文献标志码】B【ABSTRACT 】 AIM To assess the incidence，severity and sources of drug-drug interactions ( DDIs) among outpatients who visited multiple clinics at a medical center in China． METHODS This was a one week，retrospective and observational study． Mcdex，Micromedex and MIMS drug interaction databases were used to identify DDIs and to assess the severity of DDIs． RESULTS ①Incidence: A total of 2 117 patients were included． Mcdex，Micromedex and MIMS identified the numbers of 2 130，283 and 1 068 DDIs，respectively． The incidences of DDIs in the 3 compendia were 100． 1 DDIs /100 patients，13． 4 DDIs /100 patients and 50． 4 DDIs /100 patients respectively． ②Severity: A number of 31 DDIs were identified as major in at least 2 DDI compendia，which most commonly involved cardiovascular agents，antibacterial agents and central nervous system agents． ③ Sources: Of those DDIs identified by Micromedex，6． 2 inner clinic DDIs /100 patients and 7． 1 inter clinics DDIs /100 patients were identified ( 6． 2% vs 7． 1% ，P ＞ 0． 05) ． CONCLUSION ①The incidence of DDIs among outpatients who visited multiple clinics was relatively high and had clinical significance． The inter clinics DDIs should not be ignored as they accounted for half the incidence of DDIs among outpatients． ②There was a lack of consistency in the inclusion and grading of drug interactions across the 3 drug compendia． Healthcare providers should reconcile the discrepancies to get a good evaluation of DDIs． Surveillance software and pharmacist ’ s efforts should be added to identify the inter clinic DDIs．药物相互作用( drug-drug interactions，DDIs) 可致疗效增强甚至不良反应，或疗效减弱甚至治疗失败。
